description: This file implements logging functionalities, including exception dumping, system file logging, and syslog category announcements within the WPEFramework's Logging namespace.

classes.name: ExceptionCatcher
classes.description: A class implementing a callback for handling exceptions in a thread, used to dump exception information.

methods.name: ForceLinkage
methods.description: A template method to force linkage of the UnknownCallsign variable.

methods.name: DumpException
methods.description: Dumps the current call stack and exception type information to the syslog.

methods.name: DumpSystemFiles
methods.description: Logs system information such as memory info, load average, and process status to the syslog.
